title: SUM, TOTAL and overflow
statement:
In SQLite, table big(x INTEGER) contains two rows: 9223372036854775807 (the largest 64-bit integer) and 1.

Which statements are true? Pick every one that applies.
choices: SELECT SUM(x) FROM big fails with an integer overflow error.
SELECT TOTAL(x) FROM big returns a floating-point value instead of failing.
On an empty table, SUM(x) and TOTAL(x) both return NULL.
